sentences: RDNA2 ISA SOP1. saveexec: `D = EXEC; EXEC = f(S0, EXEC); SCC = (EXEC != 0)`. wrexec: `EXEC = f(S0, EXEC); D = EXEC`.
`f` is one of `and`, `or`, `xor`, `andn1` (`~S0 & EXEC`), `andn2` (`S0 & ~EXEC`), `orn1`, `orn2`, `nand`, `nor`, `xnor`, the table in `Gen.EXEC_LOGIC`.
The definitions match `tools/cf_ref.py` `_SAVEEXEC`, the FUZZ-8 model.
Each invocation holds its own lane's bit (0 or ~0), so `f` is the bitwise op on that bit.
A lane EXEC had off becomes active when `f` gives 1 for it (`nand`, `nor`, `orn1`, `orn2`, `xnor`, ...), as on hardware, and SCC is the wave vote.

CPU-checked by `tests/semantic/test_saveexec_variants.py` (all ten saveexec kinds in wave32 and wave64, both wrexec kinds, partial EXEC and S0, an empty result, every lane against `cf_ref._SAVEEXEC`) and by `tools/cf_diff.py` (300 programs × wave32/64 still pass).
**Not GPU-verified** for the seven new kinds.
